name: Carrick Dhu Holiday Park
accommodation: 35 touring caravan/motorhome pitches with electric hook-up, 20 tent pitches
beachAccess: West Bay beach within a kilometre's walk; ocean and rock pools across from the entrance
confirmedFeatures: Electric hook-up, hard-standing pitches with artificial grass
overview: A council-run park on the A2 Causeway Coastal Route at Ballyreagh Road, just outside Portrush towards Portstewart. It has 35 touring pitches with electric hook-up, bookable online, and 20 tent pitches booked by phone. The Atlantic is directly across the road from the entrance, and West Bay beach is within a kilometre's walk.
surfTripFit: A low-cost van or tent base on the coast road, a few minutes' drive from West Strand, Whiterocks and Portstewart Strand.
